subject.title: Wear: animate Talk avatar from playback audio

question: Should Wear Talk replace its existing orb-and-waveform presentation with this animated OpenClaw avatar as the default experience?
rationale: The implementation and supplied real-device proof support a viable feature, but the choice to replace a current user-facing visual is a product-direction decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Adopt the avatar
options.body: Accept the animated avatar as the canonical Wear Talk visual and proceed with normal maintainer review of the current head.

options.title: Keep the current visual
options.body: Decline the default visual replacement and close or narrow the proposal without treating the implementation as a correctness defect.

recommendation.title: Keep the current visual
recommendation.body: Decline the default visual replacement and close or narrow the proposal without treating the implementation as a correctness defect.
